## Description

The chart works out the patient's life stage: child under 18, pregnancy while a pregnancy is open (MDV-P2-034), older adult from 65, otherwise adult. The life stage drives the chart module, the consultation template and the safety checks, and is shown as a label with an icon and words, not colour alone. History is kept in sections (past medical, surgical, family, social, women's health or obstetric, birth and feeding for a child, function and falls for an older adult), each with who wrote it and when. The banner adds blood group, preferred language, the care team and the consent state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The life stage rule is tested at the edges: 17 y 364 d is a child, 18 y is an adult, 65 y is an older adult, and an open pregnancy wins over adult.
- [ ] **AC2.** A doctor or nurse can edit each history section; every save records the author and time and the previous text is kept.
- [ ] **AC3.** The banner shows blood group and language only when recorded; nothing is guessed.
- [ ] **AC4.** The history sections offered depend on the life stage (birth for a child, function for an older adult).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
